summary: Two hikers off-trail near Vista Point/Owl Creek Pass requested a welfare check; team made contact and used a makeshift litter to drag their injured dog half a mile to the road.
location: Vista Point/Owl Creek Pass, near County Road 8
notes: Paged 7 p.m.; subjects contacted after ~1 hr. Hikers uninjured. Per OMRT, canine rescue is outside the team mission statement.
